packages.name: units
packages.description: GNU unit conversion calculator, with the unit database built in
packages.notes: Interactive when run with no arguments. The database (definitions, currency, elements, CPI) is compiled into the binary; currency rates are a snapshot from 2024-02-18.

packages.name: jq
packages.notes: Includes the Oniguruma regex builtins (test, match, capture, sub, splits). Passes all 447 upstream tests under wasm3.

packages.name: sqlite3
packages.description: SQLite command-line shell, with FTS5, R*Tree and JSON
packages.notes: Databases open lock-free (the unix-none VFS): safe for one process at a time, which is what a terminal does. No WAL, no loadable extensions, no .shell/.excel.

packages.name: datamash
packages.description: GNU command-line statistics: group-by, mean, median, sum, crosstab
packages.notes: The companion 'decorate' program is not included: it needs to pipe through a real sort(1) process.

packages.name: nano
packages.description: GNU nano, the full-screen editor, with syntax highlighting built in
packages.notes: Requires direct keystroke input enabled in the host app. The 39 syntax definitions are compiled into the binary, so colouring works with nothing on disk; a nanorc in the working directory, or one named with -f, still overrides it. No subprocesses: ^T reports an error, and the spell checker, formatter and linter are not built. ^Z cannot suspend, nothing can deliver SIGWINCH so a rotate needs ^L to redraw, and ESC pressed on its own is not seen until the next key (Meta combinations are unaffected). pico is a second copy of the same binary, which is why the archive is twice its size.

packages.name: ed
packages.description: GNU ed, the standard line editor: scriptable, no cursor addressing
packages.notes: Shell escapes (!command, r !command, w !command) report an error: WASI has no subprocesses. Everything else passes the upstream testsuite. Needs a writable working directory for its buffer file.
